author: fwyzard
body:
#### PR description:

XGBoost applies the "nthread" parameter only after a model has been loaded, so loading a JSON model used one OpenMP thread per cpu and left an idle pool of OpenMP threads for the rest of the job.
Use a single OpenMP thread while loading the model.

#### PR validation:

Run 3 HLT menu creates N-1 OpenMP idle threads on `master`, and no idle thread with this PR.

Results are unchanged.
title: Do not start an OpenMP thread pool when loading XGBoost models
